name: taxes_per_line
note: account.reconcile.model.line.tax_ids many2many owner (addons/account/models/account_reconcile_model.py:51, relation account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel): taxes per write-off line with the lowest tax id, as _get_write_off_move_lines_dict applies them
source_sql: SELECT account_reconcile_model_line_id AS line_id, count(*) AS taxes, min(account_tax_id) AS first_tax FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel GROUP BY account_reconcile_model_line_id ORDER BY account_reconcile_model_line_id

name: lines_per_tax
note: inverse side: write-off lines per tax, the usage count behind an account.tax's reconcile model lines
source_sql: SELECT account_tax_id AS tax_id, count(*) AS lines FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel GROUP BY account_tax_id ORDER BY account_tax_id
